controls.name: voices
controls.doc: How many doubled voices sound beside the dry, 1 to DOUBLER_MAX_VOICES. Two comes up.

controls.name: delayMs
controls.doc: The voices' mean delay, ms: voice n sits at this times DOUBLER_VOICE_DELAYS[n].

controls.name: detuneCents
controls.doc: The voices' detune, cents: voice n is tuned by this times DOUBLER_VOICE_DETUNES[n], up for a positive factor and down for a negative one, by the Doppler of a moving read (omx_doppler), no pitch shifter.

controls.name: modRateHz
controls.doc: The rate the voices' delays drift at, Hz; each voice's drift is a further 1 / voices of a turn along.

controls.name: modDepthMs
controls.doc: How far the voices' delays drift either side of their mean, ms. 0 holds them still.

controls.name: spreadPct
controls.doc: How wide the voices sit, percent: voice n is panned to this share of DOUBLER_VOICE_PANS[n] by the console's balance law.

controls.name: mixPct
controls.doc: The share of the voices, percent: 0 is the input bit for bit, 100 the voices alone, their sum divided by the voice count.

DOUBLER_MAX_VOICES.doc: The most voices the doubler carries; its state holds this many heads.

DOUBLER_VOICE_DETUNES.doc: Each voice's share of detuneCents, signed: the first up, the second down, the third and fourth half as far, up and down.

DOUBLER_VOICE_DELAYS.doc: Each voice's share of delayMs, so the voices never land on one sample: two singers do not breathe together.

DOUBLER_VOICE_PANS.doc: Each voice's place at a spread of 100 %, -1 hard left to +1 hard right.

DOUBLER_WINDOW_MS.doc: The Doppler head's sweep, ms: the window a detuned voice's delay moves through before the crossfade re-centres it.

DOUBLER_FADE.doc: The share of the head's sweep the crossfade to the next head takes.
